purpose: Define certification as validation evidence anchored to an exact package hash and Contract Format/conformance state, separate from licensing and semantic ownership.

topics.name: Certification
topics.purpose: Define certification as validation evidence anchored to an exact package hash and Contract Format/conformance state, separate from licensing and semantic ownership.

semantics.anchor_rule: Certification token anchors an exact package hash.
semantics.conformance_rule: Certification evidence identifies applicable conformance/closure results.
semantics.first_validation_rule: Initial validation may require online registry verification; subsequent validation may use explicitly bounded/cacheable registry evidence.
semantics.separation_rule: Certification does not grant license rights, semantic ownership or runtime authorization.
semantics.change_rule: Package content change invalidates certification tied to the prior package hash.
semantics.evidence_rule: Certification result retains package, validator/registry and validation provenance.

invariants.rule: Packaging, hashing, certification and repository distribution preserve canonical semantics but do not become semantic or runtime authority.

hard_gates.condition: certification token accepted for different package hash
certification grants licensing rights by itself
changed package keeps old certification without revalidation
